process.title: How it works
process.intro: A direct conversation first. Then a clear proposal, with scope, timeline and budget agreed before development begins.

steps.title: Your need
steps.description: Identify what is slowing your business down, who will use the solution and what needs to improve.

steps.title: First contact
steps.description: Share your idea on WhatsApp. We discuss your routine, priorities and any examples you have in mind.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.description: We define what will be delivered, the timeline and the budget. You review the proposal before development begins.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I build the solution in stages and share progress for your review.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: We check the solution together and I walk you through how to use it. After delivery, maintenance can include updates, fixes and monitoring, depending on the agreed scope.

websites.label: Websites
websites.summary: For businesses that need to present their services clearly, receive inquiries or sell online.

offers.title: Company website
offers.description: Introduce your business, show what you do and give customers a clear way to get in touch.

offers.title: Landing page
offers.description: Focus a campaign or product launch on one action, from requesting a quote to joining a waitlist.

offers.title: Online store
offers.description: Organize your products and give customers a straightforward path from browsing to checkout.

internal-systems.label: ERP & systems
internal-systems.summary: For teams working across spreadsheets and disconnected tools. Centralize information and make everyday processes easier to follow.

offers.title: ERP
offers.description: Bring orders, inventory and day-to-day operations into one system shaped around your workflow.

offers.title: CRM
offers.description: Organize contacts, track opportunities and keep customer conversations in one place so your team can follow up on sales.

offers.title: Internal portal
offers.description: Give your team a place to manage requests, approvals and reports with the right permissions.

mobile-apps.label: Mobile apps
mobile-apps.summary: For businesses that want to receive orders, manage bookings and events or sell on mobile, with an experience built for their customers.

offers.title: Delivery apps
offers.description: Let customers browse your menu, place orders and track delivery in an app built for your business.

offers.title: Booking and event apps
offers.description: Make appointments and event registration easier, with availability, confirmations and useful details together on mobile.

offers.title: Sales apps
offers.description: Put your catalog on customers' phones, with product selection, a shopping cart and order tracking in your own shopping experience.
